# Reference Edge Cases

A collapsed reference with no definition: [gone][].

A shortcut reference is not checked by default: [shortcut].

Code is not a reference: `[missing][nope]`.

Escaped brackets are text: \[missing\]\[nope\].

A reference defined inside a blockquote: [quoted][].

A reference that differs only by case folding: [Straße][].

> [quoted]: https://example.com/quoted

[STRASSE]: https://example.com/strasse
